latHint: Think gossip going round town - not a bee's hum.
pivHint: A BUZZ is the hum of a bee - but the BUZZ around town is a what that everyone passes on?
winText: Word spreads. BUZZ was the pivot - a bee's hum to a RUMOR.
lossText: RUMOR - an unconfirmed story. BUZZ was the pivot: a bee BUZZ to the BUZZ in town.
